title: Advanced Algorithms
standfirst: Beyond the classics — approximation, randomised, online, and parameterised algorithms.
resources_note: An IITM email may be required for some of the resources above; any other access request will be strictly rejected.

description_paragraphs: To introduce advanced ideas in design of algorithms; To study the performance guarantees of algorithms; To introduce methods for coping with NP-hard problems.
faculty: Prof. Neeldhara Misra, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, IIT Gandhinagar

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Greedy algorithms; Interval scheduling and file storage problems; Stable matching.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Matroids and greedy optimization; Matroid properties and examples; Scheduling with deadlines.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Dynamic programming; Classic problems (LIS, edit distance, subset sum, optimal BSTs).

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Maximum flow theory; Flows, cuts, max-flow min-cut; Augmenting paths; Bipartite matching.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Applications of flows; Scheduling, elimination problems, and project selection.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Computational complexity; P , NP , NP-completeness; Reductions; SAT and classic NP-hard problems.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Approximation algorithms; Vertex cover (matching and LP-based); TSP and set cover.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Randomized algorithms; Monte Carlo vs Las Vegas; Min-cut; Probabilistic methods; 2SAT and primality testing.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Exact algorithms; Branch and bound; Inclusion-exclusion; DP for TSP; Local search.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Parameterized algorithms; Fixed-parameter tractability; Closest string; k-path; Subset DP techniques.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Kernelization techniques; Vertex cover kernels; Structural reductions; Applications to classic problems.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Practical approaches to hardness; SAT solvers; LP solvers; Problem reductions and real-world optimization.
